product_name: Handcrafted Antique Gold Peacock Tea Light Holder
description: Exquisitely handcrafted in a regal peacock motif, this metal tea light holder radiates traditional elegance and warmth. Featuring a magnificently detailed fanned tail feather backdrop and textured body artwork, the piece is finished in a warm antique gold patina. Designed with a central glass candle insert, it casts a soothing glow, making it an ideal accent piece for festive occasions, Diwali celebrations, quiet evenings, or elevated everyday home decor.
visual_features: Stylized peacock motif featuring an ornate crest and fanned feather backdrop
Detailed embossed and engraved feather texture across the body and fan
Rich antique gold metallic finish with subtle burnished dark accents
Central holder containing a clear glass cup designed for tea light candles
